name: Sprint System
description: A clean hold-to-sprint controller with configurable speed and smooth transitions.
details: A client-side sprint controller that responds to keyboard input, eases between movement speeds, and restores the default speed when the key is released.
instructions: In Roblox Studio, navigate to StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
Insert a LocalScript and name it Sprint.
Copy the provided sprint system code into the LocalScript.
Adjust the WalkSpeed and SprintSpeed settings in the CONFIGURATION section to suit your game.
Set EnableTrails to true or false to enable or disable the sprint visual effects.
Press Play to test sprinting using Left Shift, the controller's left stick button (L3), or the mobile sprint button.
notes: Input uses Left Shift by default.
